reference.sourcing: Compiled from knowledge of Prague's streets — its districts, street furniture, transport and building types — not from a live Google Street View session. Nothing here was sampled from imagery at build time; treat each entry's note as a description to check against a real street view before modelling.
reference.scale: One world unit is one metre. The player is 1.5 m tall, so every size below is in metres at that scale.
